svg.title: Walmart operations and methods: how data is extracted
svg.desc: A person chooses one of four operations on the Store Sales feed, each using GET or POST. The request returns only the matching files, and those rows are stored in the database table.
svg.text: Four operations, two methods: how the data is extracted
same feed (Store Sales); what changes is which data from it you request

g.text: Get Latest Data (GET) asks the Store Sales feed for exactly that data, and only those rows are stored.
You need: update for one date: 5 October
Get Data By FeedDate (POST) asks the Store Sales feed for exactly that data, and only those rows are stored.
You need: all available history files
Get Available History (GET) asks the Store Sales feed for exactly that data, and only those rows are stored.
Get History By FileName (POST) asks the Store Sales feed for exactly that data, and only those rows are stored.

svg.text: Example files and dates are made up for learning, not real Walmart data. Operations shown apply to the feeds discussed, not every Walmart feed.
